name: context-ring
title: Context Ring
description: How full a chat's working memory is: a small ring for the composer's toolbar, blue under 75%, amber from 75%, red from 90%, with a breakdown and Summarize now.

meta.whenToUse: Show how much of a chat's working window the last request used, in ChatComposer's toolbarEnd, with what fills it and Summarize now.
meta.whenNotToUse: Upload or task progress (Progress, UploadPanel), or money and run cost (RunUsage).
